contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper-alloy Nummus of House of Constantine, AD 337-41 (Reece period 17). GLORIA EXERCITVS. Reverse legend reads [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Reverse shows Two soldiers, one standard. Mint is Trier. See RIC VII, pp.143-5. Obverse shows laureate and cuirassed bust right. Obverse legend reads [...] AVG . Reverse fields and exergue read: - // (TRP). Condition very fine. Die axis is 12 o'clock. Weight 1.32g,…
